_what: Each farm agent is its own Routine. Every firing starts a fresh session that does only that agent's step, hands in with its own session id, then fires the next agent's Routine. Mila is one persistent session (her signing key lives only there). trigger_id is filled in when the Routine is created. All start switched OFF: the agent Routines have no schedule (they cost nothing until fired), and the dispatcher's hourly schedule stays disabled until Glam says yes.
